postconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 1 for a_i in a for _ in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each boss type is either 0 (easy) or 1 (hard).

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a) <= n for a in [a for _, a in test_cases])
postconditions.description: The total number of hard bosses does not exceed the total number of bosses.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [n for _, n in test_cases])
postconditions.description: The number of bosses in each test case is between 1 and 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 2 * 10**4 for t in [t for t, _ in test_cases])
postconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 20,000.

invariants.expression: all(len(a) == n for a in [a for _, a in test_cases])
invariants.description: Each test case contains exactly n boss types.
